rationale: All four 8.59 ns runs finished ~1.4 ns positive, so timing repair never engages at the floor target; T_eff reflects the AREA 3 netlist and placement. Electrical/synthesis tweaks looked neutral (ABC buffering+sizing, 40/40 repair, post-GRT design repair); other strategies scored 0.7-5 ns worse. Floorplan is the live lever: tight-target T_eff rose with density (57%: 7.15, 65%: 7.27, 70%: 7.38), and a fit hints higher util helps (smaller die, shorter IO wires; ocs implies IO paths sit ~0.25 ns from critical). Two orthogonal one-step probes from the best run: A lowers density to 52% at util 42; B raises util to 48 at the same 57% density. 0.4 ns margins keep the re-check robust.
